title: Report on the Historical Record of U.S. Government Involvement with UAP, Volume I (AARO, Feb 2024)
doc_notes: This is a historical report by AARO reviewing USG involvement with UAP since 1945, which includes summaries of various interviewee claims and the office's investigative findings.

encounters.summary: Kenneth Arnold reported seeing nine large circular objects flying in formation near Mount Rainier, Washington, which he described as saucer-like.
An interviewee claimed that in the 1990s he overheard a conversation between two military bases where scientists claimed aliens were present during a materials test.
encounters.communication_content: Scientists discussing the presence of aliens during a materials test.
encounters.quote: aliens were present during specialized materials testing

encounters.summary: An interviewee claimed a former senior U.S. military officer told him he touched an extraterrestrial spacecraft floating in a building.
encounters.communication_content: Detailed description of a craft floating in a building and the program details.
encounters.quote: touched the surface of an extraterrestrial spacecraft

encounters.summary: A former U.S. service member claimed to have seen U.S. Special Forces loading containers onto a large extraterrestrial spacecraft in 2009.
encounters.quote: encountered U.S. Special Forces loading containers onto a large extraterrestrial spacecraft

encounters.summary: Former USAF members claimed UAP sightings near ICBM silos and disruptions to operations, including power failures and a claim of a UAP destroying a dummy warhead mid-flight.
encounters.location_name: Malmstrom, Ellsworth, Vandenberg, and Minot USAF bases
encounters.quote: UAP destroying an ICBM loaded with a dummy warhead
